description: We are a team of 3 in 9th grade, and we are passionate about NASA and coding. Our project is a satellite launching game. It helps people understand the different parts of a satellite that helps it launch. It provides accurate NASA data for fuel, distance, budget, etc. It’s an interactive and engaging game that incorporates real life data. It contains different paths to go on, moon, mars, or outer space. Overall, this is an educational game that can help you learn new things in a fun way.

details: Our project enlightens people about the problems a mission can face while executing a project. It also creates an understanding of the different parts that are required to form a satellite. Our game is a fun and interactive way to learn. We used Javascript from p5.js. Our project is creative because it is colorful and graphic. We considered the budget, weight, power, fuel, and communication, we also considered the crisis (problems that can occur) through out the mission. We included two options for the user they can either play solo or two player.
